_scope_note: Machine-readable source of truth for Issue #5 Task F lane decisions. Every 'decision' value MUST be one of the six values Issue #5 permits (ADOPT_FOR_P0_PROTOTYPE, KEEP_AS_BENCHMARK_ONLY, REIMPLEMENT_SMALLER_EQUIVALENT, PORT/EXPORT_EXPERIMENT_NEXT, REJECT, BLOCKED_PENDING_LICENSE) -- asserted by eval/verify_repair.py. PM REVIEW #2 R11: 'UNRESOLVED' is not a valid value and has been removed everywhere.

beat_timestamps.status_note: Real, strong beat-timestamp accuracy on canonical fresh-per-call results, including under deliberate phase-offset and variable-tempo stress fixtures where the scalar-BPM negative baseline collapses. Benchmark-only per the artifact license matrix; not a production-shipping decision.

downbeats_bar_phase.status_note: Beat tracking strong; downbeat/meter selection not reliably validated on this pass's synthetic fixtures (systematic meter=2 misclassification on all 8, including the true-3/4 fixture). Needs real-music validation before any adoption decision.

meter.status_note: 0 of 8 fixtures correctly classified this pass.

cue_points.status_note: Real execution, plausible qualitative behavior on synthetic material, but smoke-test only (no authored cue ground truth this pass) and EDM-domain-specific per the standing P0 concern. 4 of 11 raw predictions across the 8-fixture set were out-of-duration/negative and filtered.

phrase_candidates.status_note: Directly disproven as a phrase-detection method: on FIX-F's 4 real authored phrase boundaries, TP=4/FP=1/FN=0 -- coincidental overlap plus one musically baseless spurious boundary.
